# Coach Gopi

> Coach Gopi (Gopi D) is a UESCA Certified Running Coach and Certified Nutrition & Diet Coach in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He has trained runners since 2016 and offers running coaching (online and supervised at Riverfront, Ahmedabad), nutrition and diet coaching, corporate wellness programmes, and running event management and race direction.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.coach-gopi.com/): Overview of running, wellness, nutrition and event services.
- [Running coaching](https://www.coach-gopi.com/running-coach-ahmedabad/): Coaching for beginners to ultra runners, fees, and a free 12-week beginner-to-10K plan.
- [Nutrition & diet coaching](https://www.coach-gopi.com/nutrition-diet-coach-ahmedabad/): Personalised diet guidance and weight-management support, with fees.
- [Corporate wellness](https://www.coach-gopi.com/corporate-wellness-ahmedabad/): Step challenges, walking and running campaigns, department competitions and group sessions for companies.
- [Events & race management](https://www.coach-gopi.com/running-event-management-consultant-ahmedabad/): Event coordination, technical guidance, timing-team coordination, promotion and race-day support.
- [About Coach Gopi](https://www.coach-gopi.com/about-coach-gopi/): Credentials, race-pacing experience, Riverfront Runners Group mentoring, ADR leadership.
- [Contact](https://www.coach-gopi.com/contact/): Enquiry form for all services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.coach-gopi.com/privacy-policy/): What personal details the website collects and who else sees them.
- [Terms & Disclaimer](https://www.coach-gopi.com/terms-and-disclaimer/): Terms of use, health disclaimer and service terms.

## Key facts
- Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Online coaching is available outside Ahmedabad.
- Credentials: UESCA Certified Running Coach (United Endurance Sports Coaching Academy, issued 3 February 2026, valid to 3 February 2028); Certified Nutrition & Diet Coach.
- Community: mentors runners with Riverfront Runners Group, Ahmedabad; founded ADR CK in 2016; President of ADR from July 2022 to June 2023.
- Who it is for: beginners starting with 5K, runners training for 10K, half marathon, full marathon and ultra distances, people wanting diet and weight-management support, companies running employee wellness programmes, and organisers of running events.
- How to start: send an enquiry through the contact page (https://www.coach-gopi.com/contact/) or book a consultation from any service page.
- Running coaching fees per month (3, 6, 12 month commitments): online Rs 2,750 / 2,625 / 2,500; physical at Riverfront (8 sessions a month) Rs 4,800 / 4,650 / 4,500; nutrition add-on Rs 1,750 / 1,600 / 1,500. Minimum commitment is 3 months.
- Standalone nutrition and diet plan per month: Rs 2,750 / 2,600 / 2,500.
- Race pacing: 20 half marathons at 2:30, 6 10K races at 70 minutes, one full marathon under 5 hours.
- Free resource: 12-week beginner-to-10K plan on the running coaching page (general self-guided resource, not individual medical or training advice).
